description: This file defines a React component for a system monitoring dashboard, including state management, data fetching, and rendering various monitoring components such as MetricsCard, SystemHealth, AlertsList, and PerformanceChart. It is the main page component for rendering the monitoring interface.

methods.name: loadMetrics
methods.description: Fetches system metrics from the API endpoint '/monitoring/metrics' and handles success or failure cases, updating component state accordingly.
